compare_start.title: Kellie's Voice v3 verification test
compare_start.description: This is a temporary two-minute LAN test. Home Assistant and the TV will derive a matching eight-digit code without exchanging account credentials. Your normal Kellie's Voice integration will not be changed. Start the v3 test window on the TV first.

data.start: Start the secure v3 code test

compare_code.title: Compare the code on both screens
compare_code.description: Home Assistant calculated {code}. Compare ALL EIGHT DIGITS against the code displayed on the actual TV, then press OK on the TV remote. Confirm here afterwards. This DOES NOT sign the TV in.

data.numbers_match: All eight digits match the TV and I pressed remote OK

error.unavailable: Could not complete the temporary v3 exchange. Restart on the TV.
error.waiting_for_remote: No physical TV remote confirmation yet. Compare the codes, press OK on the TV and try again.

abort.start_on_tv: On the TV, open the v3 test screen and press START first. Then select the discovered TV in Devices & Services.
abort.invalid_tv: The TV's temporary v3 advertisement was invalid.
abort.cancelled: Verification was cancelled. Your normal TV login was not changed.
abort.expired: The temporary TV session expired or its proof was rejected. Try a new session.
abort.mismatch: The eight-digit codes did not match. Nothing was changed.
abort.verified_test_only: Secure v3 TV code and physical remote verified! This is a test only. No Home Assistant login or token was installed.
